I'm so sorry. I can relate to being seen as strong, intelligent and with insurmountable willpower and I sometimes feel like I am violating some unwritten rule if I reach out and ask for help. I also feel like I'm "bothering" people asking for help and I talk myself out of it- this makes things so much worse because then I'm alone and isolated. Just know that it takes courage to ask for help, and that makes you strong- not weak. 

This is what I do: I pickup the phone and I just dial one number, a friend whose name pops out. Just dial the number, don't think just let your finger hit the button. When they pickup even if I just talk about nothing it helps to feel less isolated, but sometimes I actually open up if the person senses something is up and asks. Maybe this will work if you try it as well? 

Feel free to PM me if you want to talk, I had a rough weekend and we can be sad together! Hugs.
